statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting ending 2026-10-28. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the Federal Reserve statement of 2026-10-28 or FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-10-29 shows a target-range upper bound above 4.00 percent. Reference: 4.00 percent on 2026-10-12.
failure_condition: The FOMC leaves the target range upper bound at or below 4.00 percent at its 2026-10-28 decision.

statement: The BLS release scheduled for 2026-10-14 shows the September 2026 CPI-U all-items 12-month change at or above 3.7 percent. Reference: 3.4 percent for August 2026, the latest reading on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the BLS Consumer Price Index release of 2026-10-14 (FRED CPIAUCNS) shows September 2026 all-items CPI-U up 3.7 percent or more over 12 months, not seasonally adjusted. Reference: 3.4 percent for August 2026.
failure_condition: The September 2026 CPI-U all-items 12-month change is 3.6 percent or lower, or BLS has not published the September figure by the deadline.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures (January 2027 contract) settle above 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-11-13. Reference: front-month Brent at 106.95 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Brent front-month futures settlement price for 2026-11-13 is above 100.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 106.95 on 2026-10-12.
failure_condition: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or below 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-11-13.

statement: CISA adds the critical SonicWall SMA 1000 vulnerability CVE-2026-102255 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON lists CVE-2026-102255 with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA does not add CVE-2026-102255 to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.

statement: CISA adds the maximum-severity GitLab code execution vulnerability CVE-2026-97229 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON lists CVE-2026-97229 with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA does not add CVE-2026-97229 to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.

statement: The United States military carries out at least one strike on Houthi targets in Yemen between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-02, publicly confirmed by US Central Command, the Pentagon or the White House.
resolution: TRUE if US Central Command, the Pentagon or the White House publicly confirms a US strike on Houthi targets in Yemen carried out between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-02, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: The United States carries out no officially confirmed strike on Houthi targets in Yemen between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-02.

statement: Ukrainian forces strike at least one oil refinery inside internationally recognized Russian territory between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-26, with the strike publicly confirmed by the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
resolution: TRUE if the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine publicly confirms a Ukrainian strike on an oil refinery inside Russia carried out between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-26, as reported by Reuters, AP or the Kyiv Independent.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian strike on an oil refinery inside Russia confirmed by the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine takes place between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-26.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls as of 2026-12-15 show Democratic candidates winning 218 or more US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win fewer than 218 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.

statement: A federal indictment, criminal information or criminal complaint naming Representative Ilhan Omar as a defendant is filed or unsealed in a US district court between 2026-10-13 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: TRUE if a federal court docket (PACER or CourtListener) or a Justice Department release shows a charging document naming Ilhan Omar as defendant filed or unsealed between 2026-10-13 and 2027-01-15.
failure_condition: No federal charging document naming Ilhan Omar as a defendant is filed or unsealed between 2026-10-13 and 2027-01-15.

statement: At least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 150 km of the epicenter of the M 7.7 Panama earthquake (USGS event us6000u18k) with origin time between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS ComCat catalog lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 150 km of the us6000u18k epicenter with origin time between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 150 km of the us6000u18k epicenter between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12 UTC.
